## Checklist

- [ ] Tests call the real public API (see CONTRIBUTING.md); coverage gate still passes (`mix test --cover`)
- [ ] `mix format`, `mix credo --strict`, `mix dialyzer`, `mix docs` are clean
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md `[Unreleased]` entry added (Added / Changed / Fixed / Removed)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (module docs, README, AGENTS.md)
- [ ] Public API additions carry `@doc since: "<next version>"`
